title: Ensuring Fairness with Transparent Auditing of Quantitative Bias in AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on fairness metrics related to race, age, and sex in the context of criminal justice recidivism prediction.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
